summary: Phase 2 (F-11..F-16) tested on backend and frontend. Backend: the new suite test_ensaio_phase2.py passes 18/18. It covers openapi.json, /stt/engines, the Deepgram and Gemini tokens (no raw key in either response), /voices returning provider edge, distinct Edge combos for the demo characters, /tts for a character (edge, 'pt-PT-DuarteNeural -12Hz -6%') and for the prompter (edge, 'pt-PT-RaquelNeural +4Hz +12%'), PUT with an invalid edge_voice returning 400, pitch/rate changes persisting, auto-voices giving distinct combos without the prompter's combo, the MARTA line 3 variant advancing, homophones ('Ainda tás aqui? Há espera.' gives 100 with no differences), a meaning change reaching the summary, a fully correct read-through (no differences, score 100, stats.discarded present), blocks [2,4] (expected is the concatenation and the turn advances; mixing in another character's line or a stage direction returns 400 'Bloco inválido'), and the background confirmation reaching review=done within 20s with statuses real or discarded. Exploratory probes: 'nunca cá estás' and 'já cá não estás' are interrupted in grave mode and confirmed as real. Omitting 'Dez minutos.' is confirmed as real (it is not interrupted in grave mode, judged minor). A block error is attributed to the correct line (fazes→comes on line 4). BUG: removing the negation ('não sabia' → 'sabia') is interrupted by the AI ('Falhaste o não'), but the Claude confirmation then DISCARDS it in 3 of 3 runs, so the final report omits a meaning-changing error and final_accuracy is 100. Frontend: the Vozes tab shows the info text, 'Apontador: Raquel · +4Hz · +12%', the engine select (Edge/OpenAI/ElevenLabs), the voice select (Duarte/Raquel), and the TOM/RITMO sliders with value labels. Preview returned 200 edge with the right voice. A slider change via the keyboard (0→+2Hz) persisted after reload. auto-voices works with no duplicate warnings. Rehearsal: with the fake mic the badge reads 'ESCUTA: DEEPGRAM' and the WebSocket wss://api.deepgram.com/v1/listen?model=nova-3&language=pt-PT opens. When I forced /stt/deepgram-token to return 503, the badge changed to 'ESCUTA: GEMINI' (Gemini WS opened) and the notice appeared. With both tokens blocked the badge shows 'ESCUTA DO BROWSER' and text still advances. Text mode ('Só escrita'): all 6 MARTA lines were submitted, the AI lines played with Edge (JOÃO Duarte +0/+0, CHEFE Duarte -12/-6), and the summary shows 100% and 'Nenhuma diferença. Texto dito tal e qual.' A consecutive block shows data-block-size=2 and the label 'A TUA FALA · 2 FALAS SEGUIDAS' with both lines. The block turn was stored with line_idxs [2,4], and the session auto-finished at the end of the script with score 100. Regression: Library, the Guião/Memória/Ensaios/Vozes tabs and Novo texto (paste) all work. The new characters got INÊS→Raquel and PEDRO→Duarte. No JS page errors and no TTS FALLBACK entries in the logs.

minor.issue: A negation omission (expected 'nao', said '') is marked 'discarded' by the Claude haiku confirmation in 3 of 3 runs, even though the same turn was interrupted by the AI with 'Falhaste o não'. The prompt rule 'uma palavra curta em falta ... é quase sempre erro de reconhecimento' overrides the meaning change. Result: summary.differences is missing a real meaning change, final_accuracy is 100 and the turn is counted in stats.discarded. Repro: session A Espera as MARTA (grave), turn line_idx 5 said = the line with 'não sabia' replaced by 'sabia', then finish.

Dropping a whole sentence of a short line ('Ouviste? Dez minutos.' said as 'Ouviste?', accuracy 33) is judged 'minor' by the LLM and not interrupted. It is reported as real in the summary. This may be acceptable for grave mode.
If line_idx is not the first item of line_idxs (e.g. line_idx=4, line_idxs=[2,4]), the request is accepted and the turn is stored with line_idx=2. Harmless, but undocumented.

issues: The slider range is ±30 while the backend accepts ±50. Fine, just note the asymmetry.

action_items: Fix confirmation of negation changes: in confirm_turn, force status 'real' for differences whose expected or said contains a NEGATIONS word (nao/nunca/nem/ninguem/nada/jamais) when the turn was interrupted or the mode is 'escrito'. Or change CONFIRM_SYSTEM so it excludes negations from the 'short word = ASR error' rule (keeping in mind that Deepgram sometimes drops 'não' in voice mode, so prefer at least a 'real' rule when the turn mode is 'escrito')
Optional: decide whether grave mode should interrupt when a full sentence is omitted from a short line
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has 1194 lines. Split it (tts/voices, stt, sessions/evaluation, scripts).

There is an inconsistency between the turn judge (TURN_SYSTEM interrupts on the 'não' omission) and the confirmation (CONFIRM_SYSTEM discards it). The two prompts disagree on negations, which produces an interruption the final report never mentions.
A new Deepgram token (ttl 120s) is fetched for every block or reconnect. Fine, but every clear() makes a network round-trip before audio flows (audio is queued, so no words are lost).

A single human mic test with real speech is still needed: Deepgram/Gemini accuracy, failover keeping already-captured words in the middle of a turn, and the transcript clearing between blocks. Headless only verified the connections and the badge.

success_rate.backend: 100% (18/18 suite); 1 logic issue found by exploratory probe

seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_P2* scripts were created and deleted. Several sessions were created on the demo 'A Espera' and show in the Ensaios tab. The demo voices were restored with auto-voices (JOÃO Duarte 0/0, MARTA Raquel 0/0, CHEFE Duarte -12/-6).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_ensaio_phase2.py -n 0. POST /api/scripts takes {title, text}, not raw_text. The demo script is looked up by title 'A Espera'. To test STT failover headless, page.route '**/api/stt/deepgram-token' (and gemini-token) and fulfil with 503; the badge data-engine attribute goes deepgram → gemini → webspeech. The fake mic in headless opens a real Deepgram WS. The rehearsal auto-finishes when the script ends, so finish-rehearsal-btn becomes disabled. The test_ensaio_round5.py expectations for ElevenLabs/Scribe are superseded.
